decision_rationale: This is a primary DNA foundation-model paper, not a review/resource/wrapper. The evidence describes DNA sequence tokenization and fine-tuning on promoter/splice-site/species tasks, but no substantive natural-language text component or text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: "a family of open-source foundational DNA language models"; "BPE tokenization ... vocabulary comprised of ['A', 'T', 'G', 'C', 'N']"; "for promoter and splice site prediction tasks"; "species classification task"
